Those 578 URLs were regex-swept for bath|bad|mirror|soap|towel|shower|toilet|spejl|vanity. The sweep returns exactly FOUR hits and all four are the mirrors: /product/Arced-Mirror/, /product/Framed-Mirror/, /product/Gaze-Mirror/, /product/Pleat-Mirror/. ZERO hits for bath, soap, towel, shower, toilet or vanity across the whole catalogue. The full 378-item product list was then read by eye for bathroom-adjacent stock that a keyword sweep could miss, and the nearest misses were all classified and rejected on primary product type (rule 2): Tub Jug is a water jug in Accessories > Kitchen, not a bathtub; Restore Basket, Restore Round Basket and Restore Tray are felt storage baskets and a tray in Accessories > Storage (general Storage, rules 30-33); Reduce Paper Bin is a waste-paper bin for office use; Platform Tray, Wave Tray and Groove Trivet are table/serving items; Attach, Coil, Folded and Dots are coat hooks in Accessories > Hangers; Story Pinboard and Sketch Toolbox are office items. Not one product in Muuto's range is a bathroom fitting, fixture, accessory or piece of bathroom hardware. LOCALE: muuto.com is a single-host, single-locale English site. All page canonicals are self-referential (/products/accessories/, /products/accessories/mirrors/, /products/accessories/hangers/ each canonicalise to themselves), so blind spot (a) canonical aliasing does not apply either.
